CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing/access origin are explicitly linked for the candidate referent.

COD.rationale: For p1/current/n0 the content (red), its spatial presentation (coordinate set) and a distinct origin/status field are all explicitly present.

A.rationale: A processing/access origin (native_conditional_record, executed_branch_claim=false) is explicitly tied to the same candidate content's presentation.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies grid cell contents with colour attributes for named referents.

D.rationale: Origin/metadata fields separately attribute provenance/status distinct from the content coordinate lists.

O.rationale: The text specifies how coordinates map to spatial layout and gives coordinate sets showing content presentation.
